intent: Retain and quarantine the native preparation owner when cancellation rejects a newly opened engine and its destructor fails, including native runner and ViewModel ownership propagation.
constraints: Preserve every existing method, test and benchmark cap.
Only an observed destructor failure can mark cleanup unconfirmed; cancellation alone cannot quarantine ownership.
Keep the native handle, model lease and process-wide speech ownership retained until confirmed cleanup or process restart.
Do not modify SDK deadline handling, generated inventory/reference metadata, public branches or PR state.
Use ordinary project regressions; do not substitute a Kotlin harness for Android project qualification.
acceptance: Cancellation after native preparation opens a handle closes it once before returning the cancellation.
If that close fails, preserve the original cancellation and close cause, retain the actual failed owner, report failed cleanup, and prevent another backend or speech owner.
Successful preparation cleanup retains existing cancellation behavior and releases ownership normally.
The ViewModel carries failed native preparation ownership into its existing process-wide quarantine and retains the model lease.
implementation: The factory-owned preparation retirement helper closes rejected native handles once, preserves the original throwable, and retains the handle plus suppressed destructor failure if cleanup fails.

The native runner retains the failed preparation factory and reports FAILED cleanup even when creation returned no engine. Cancellation keeps its run state while preserving NATIVE_CLEANUP_PENDING as the issue.
The ViewModel passes the failed factory into the runner before clearing active preparation, so its existing quarantine retains the native owner, model lease and process-wide speech lease.

Three ordinary JUnit methods cover failed and successful cancellation cleanup, model-removal blocking, replacement-owner refusal, original runtime/cancellation failure preservation, and successful preparation transfer. Native loading is an explicit fake boundary; JNI/device qualification is not claimed.

validation.scope: All changed Kotlin production and test files.

Reviewed handle retention, original failure preservation, factory/runner/ViewModel propagation, cancellation issue precedence, and composed ordinary-test type plausibility. This is not test execution.
The integration owner retains the combined-source Android/Gradle and device qualification gates. No substitute compiler harness was run.
The integration owner will add the new helper/test to central navigation and required-test metadata, then regenerate reference hashes.
